raw.title: Add Routebase (OpenAPI-native API lifecycle platform)
raw.body:
## Tool Properties

- Display name: Routebase
- Description: Routebase is an OpenAPI-native platform that keeps an API as a single source of truth. Teams design their OpenAPI description in a visual editor, then generate documentation portals, mock servers, contract tests, and drift monitoring from that one description. It also ships a built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI agents work from the same OpenAPI description.
- Repository: N/A (commercial SaaS, not open source)
- Homepage: https://routebase.dev/

## OpenAPI Versions

- 3.1: true
- 3.0: true
- 2.0: false
